# BlazePhoenix API

> Source of the BlazePhoenix HTTP API (`https://blazephoenix.xyz/api`) and the remote MCP endpoint (`https://blazephoenix.xyz/mcp`), a Cloudflare Worker published so anyone can read what they integrate with. BlazePhoenix is the on-chain DEX aggregator on Base, Ethereum, Optimism, Arbitrum and Robinhood Chain.

The API is free and keyless: no API key, no signup, open CORS. Quotes run on your RPC node, not ours. `GET /api/quote/prepare` returns the exact `eth_call` to run on your node; `POST /api/quote/decode` is a pure function that turns your node's answer into the quote, the Phoenix Check verdict and, with a `recipient`, verified unsigned Router calldata. The retired relay endpoints (`GET /api/quote`, `POST /api/quote/batch`) answer `400 rpc_required` with the prepared call inline.

Limits: `POST /api/quote/prepare` takes up to 32 requests (returned as one JSON-RPC batch for your node), and `POST /api/quote/decode` up to 32 items. The other read endpoints (`/api/stats`, `/api/tape`, `/api/badge`, `/api/verify`, `/solvency`) read the chain from our side and need no node from you.

Quote flow:

```bash
curl 'https://blazephoenix.xyz/api/quote/prepare?chain=base&tokenIn=WETH&tokenOut=USDC&amountIn=1000000000000000000'
# run the returned eth_call (`rpcRequest`, or the ready-made `curl`) on your own node, then:
curl -X POST https://blazephoenix.xyz/api/quote/decode -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"request": <request from prepare>, "result": "<your node's eth_call result>"}'
```

In-process instead of HTTP: `npm i @blazephoenix/sdk viem`, or the local MCP server `npx -y @blazephoenix/mcp`, both reading your node from `BLAZEPHOENIX_RPC_URL` or `BLAZEPHOENIX_RPC_<CHAIN>`.

Remote MCP tools: `prepare_quote`, `decode_quote`, `get_deployments`, `get_abi`.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/blazephoenixxyz-crypto/Blaze-Phoenix-API/main/README.md): endpoints, cost and limits, layout, how this tree relates to production
- [OpenAPI 3.1](https://blazephoenix.xyz/api/openapi.json): the authoritative request and response shapes
- [API discovery root](https://blazephoenix.xyz/api): endpoints, docs and SDK as JSON
- [Security policy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/blazephoenixxyz-crypto/Blaze-Phoenix-API/main/SECURITY.md): scope and how to report a vulnerability

## Source

- [worker/quoteApi.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/blazephoenixxyz-crypto/Blaze-Phoenix-API/main/worker/quoteApi.ts): the `/api/*` routes
- [worker/codec.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/blazephoenixxyz-crypto/Blaze-Phoenix-API/main/worker/codec.ts): prepare and decode, the pure quote codec
- [worker/mcp.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/blazephoenixxyz-crypto/Blaze-Phoenix-API/main/worker/mcp.ts): the remote MCP endpoint
